# MovieLens Recommender API

- Use Python with FastAPI for the HTTP layer.
- Keep recommendation logic in `app/recommender.py` and API wiring in `app/main.py`.
- Run tests with `uv run pytest`, Python commands with `uv run python ...`, and start the service with `uv run fastapi run`.
- Keep changes focused and preserve the public endpoint contracts documented in `README.md`.
